_file: output-routing.json — SOURCE, human-edited. Every deliverable is written to git and delivered as a pull request. SharePoint is a one-way mirror of merged documents, for readers without repo access. Ships usable with zero edits; edit only to add a class or change what gets mirrored.

mirror._comment: Classes a stakeholder outside the repo needs to read. Copied to SharePoint AFTER merge, via the mirror-to-sharepoint skill. One-way — the mirror is never a source of truth.
